title: The rook cuts off space
body: A rook wins by fencing the enemy king in. Your king then walks up to help.

title: Think about cutting off the king
body: The rook should reduce the enemy king's space before the final mate.

title: What is White's plan?
question: What should White try to do first?

choices.label: Cut off the king and bring the king in

successText: Correct. Restriction first, then king support.
errorText: Not quite. The rook should reduce the enemy king's space.

title: Cut off the king
body: Move the rook from g2 to g7 to trap the black king on the edge.
successText: Good. The rook has cut the king off.
errorText: Try again. Move the rook to g7.

title: Now bring your king closer
body: Once the king is boxed in, your own king must help take away the final escape squares.

title: Lesson recap
body: With rook vs king, cut the king off first, then bring your king in to help deliver mate.
